text: Entry Requirements 1. Applicants holding valid foreign passports and in good health, with a high school degree or above. 2. Be aged over 16, those who are under 18 before August 31 of the application year, please visit Downloadto download and submit GUARANTEE STATEMENT. 3. Comply with the regulations （JW〔2020〕No. 12） issued by Ministry of Education of People’s Republic of China. 4. Applicants should meet the following language requirements English-taught Programs: minimum requirements of TOEFL 80 or IELTS 6.0 or Duolingo 105. Those who can provide English-taught proof for previous degrees or native English speakers do not need to submit the English Proficiency Certificate. 5. CSCA scores are preferred for priority admission, CSCA Test Subjects download here . Note: Tuition of the 3rd year: ECUST Tuition +Estimated International Tuition of £ 32,350
